title: Page 5
content_zh:
夏羽柔扪心自问，还真没有，但她心里闷，正要开口说话——窗户突然响起叩叩两声。
沈阿莲粉脸一红，娇嗔道：「怎么这时候来，这木头！」
夏羽柔是在沈阿莲的闺房里窝着，自然坐没坐相，听到这句话，她立即坐正了，但更令她惊愕的是，原本关上的窗户被了。
「这——这——阿柔，你没看到，不是，你不可以说出去，阿春他——我爹娘拘得太紧，可是我们想见面，到底是哪个乌龟王八蛋说成亲前三个月是不能见面的。」
夏羽柔看着又羞又怒的沈阿莲，必须说，此时的她是认识以来，最漂亮的样子。
她脸泛桃花，娇羞可人，看着呆站一旁手足无措的阿春，她左手搥他胸部，右手又是捏他腰的，尽现女儿娇态。
再看阿春，他面对沈阿莲的双手频往他身上招呼只是呵呵傻笑，然后目光看向她，尴尬点头，算是打招呼，想了一下，又不好意思的摸头道：「我们成亲那日要麻烦夏娘子了。」
「什么夏娘子，她是我姊妹，你要喊她阿柔姊。」沈阿莲又瞪他一眼。
「阿柔姊好，呃——拜托你了。」
阿春虽然还年少，可是五官长得极好，身材高大，皮肤晒得黝黑，很适合沈阿莲，让她得以小鸟依人。
两人都不忘拜托她不能说出他翻窗的事。
「不会的，我发誓。」她再三保证，煞有其事的举起右手。
「其实阿春是觉得不好，他怕我阿爹会以为他不庄重也不尊重我，但他拗不过我啦，我就是想见他，想见他，真的很想见他……」
沈阿莲看着憨笑的良人，羞答答的说着，笑得好甜。
面对这样幸福的两人，夏羽柔心底的某根弦也被勾动了，这一幕，居然久久挥之不去。
回到夏家食堂后方的大厨房，夏羽柔挽起衣袖准备晚膳，但老是失神，最后还是逼自己不去理会脑袋的某个声音，卯足劲做了烤鸭二吃。
鸭皮烧烤色泽鲜亮，鸭肉鲜嫩多汁，肥而不腻，一部分热炒，一部分削成片片带皮薄肉，裹在薄薄饼皮卷上青葱段，一看就好吃。
四个大灶分别或炖或煮汤，夏羽柔走到一个木架前，取了腊肉，再从小冰窖里，拿出从沈阿莲那边回来时，特别绕到最近的肉摊子买的猪绞肉，另外再从水缸里捞一尾活鱼。
她俐落剖鱼时，另一个灶上锅里已冒出热气，饭菜香丝丝袅袅的飘了出去。
「阿柔，我来了。」

是叶嬷嬷，沈阿莲的喜宴，叶嬷嬷要当她的帮手，所以这几日备晚膳，她都会过来帮忙，也一起用膳，先练练喜宴菜色。
今天的烤鸭二吃就是其中一道，所以鸭肉切片，她只切一小部分，其余让叶嬷嬷练习。
夏羽柔边忙碌边注意时间，汤绍玄已过来上课，她得加快动作，她回头看桌上的菜色，还有汤没做，她开始调馅，要包猪肉馄饨。
正忙着，汤绍玄竟然走进厨房。
这些日子，他虽然会对她的菜毫不客气的批评指教，可那是在用餐时，地点也在饭厅，他曾说：「君子远庖厨。」
但现下她可不敢吐槽，她心绪复杂，连看都不敢看他，因为从沈家离开后，她的脑海一直不停的回绕着沈阿莲的那句话——
「我就是想见他，想见他，真的很想见他……」
这让她回家的一路上，无法抑制心里的冲动，频频往采石场的方向看。
她知道她的心正强烈的鼓噪着，去见他、去见他、去见他——每一次的心跳，伴随的都是这些渴望见他的声音。
但这是不对的，她总是个下堂妻。
所以今天汤绍玄来上课，她破天荒的避开他的目光，开门让他进来，就往厨房里钻，不似过往还陪着他一路到弟弟的房间，说个没完没了。
夏羽柔不知道，就是她这个破天荒，让汤绍玄进了厨房。
他也不知道自己怎么了，察觉夏羽柔躲避着他，他上课无法专心，甚至烦躁，他还问夏羽晨，「夏娘子今天怎么了？」
「姊怎么了吗？」
夏羽晨茫然的表情，莫名让他发火，自己的姊姊不对劲，当弟弟的竟然毫无所觉？于是，他迁怒似的出了一大堆作业给他，自己来到厨房。
「你不舒服？」他问。
心都没了，能舒服吗？她哀怨的瞪着偷心的男人。
过去她百般讨好，耍赖卖乖，让吴奕、沈铭等人把她跟汤绍玄凑成堆，她也满不在乎，觉得反正也不可能成真，就算成真也是她赚到，但她怎么都没想到，她会先把自己的一颗心送出去，这买卖太不划算了。
「我惹你了？」汤绍玄蹙眉又问。
当然是你，不是你还有谁？偷心贼！还装无辜，我鄙视你！夏羽柔在心里愤愤骂道。

汤绍玄眉头拢得更紧，「阴阳怪气，你怎么回事？」
他脸色陡地一沉，她才恍然回神，要死，她是疯了？忘了他是谁？
求生欲极强的她立即回魂，狗腿子上身，「没没没，这不是事情多，想出神了吗，汤爷，呃——你怎进来了？饿了吗？我这馄饨包好下锅，晚膳就好了，再等一会儿。」
叶嬷嬷笑咪咪的看着两人，都没插话，旁观者清，汤绍玄这是关心起夏羽柔，不然哪会进来这烟燻火燎的厨房。
天色愈黑了，叶嬷嬷也加入包馄饨的行列，夏羽柔也加快动作，但汤某人没动手，只看着她们包，叶嬷嬷对两个年轻人同处一室的状态很开心，话就多了。
「要我说啊，这道馄饨也可以在阿莲成亲那天的喜宴亮亮相，我吃过几回，真是好吃啊，」她边说动作也没停，「我打小就爱吃这玩意儿，我娘也说了，这调馅的肉都要当日新鲜宰杀的猪肉最好，皮要……」
「薄透弹牙。」汤绍玄跟夏羽柔异口同声道，一个会吃，一个会煮，这阵子在吃食上有来有往，还真的心有灵犀了。
「呵呵呵，真没想到阿柔与汤爷这么有默契。」叶嬷嬷笑说。
「可不是吗？」夏羽柔笑得骄傲，但一想到何忠的话，她又脸红了，她跟他心灵相通呢……不，不对，她又忘了自己是下堂妇了！
汤绍玄见她神情变了又变，「怎么了？」
她扯了扯嘴角，「没事啊，就是跟汤爷有默契，开心的，哈哈。」莫名的窘迫，让她不小心一用力，将皮弄破了，她又嘀咕起来，「我在干啥？呃——八成汤爷长得太好看，靠这么近，我就紧张了，你要不要先出去？我犯花痴呢。」
意识到自己说了什么胡话，她想也没想的就摀住自己的嘴，却忘了手上沾着黏糊的生肉馅，她急忙跑到水槽前去吐掉。
汤绍玄低低一笑。
叶嬷嬷也笑出来，来回看着两人，频频点头。
怎么一直出糗，她要疯了，夏羽柔漱漱口，又想到汤绍玄最近笑容渐多——
扪心自问，他开心，她就真的开心，所以，他偷走她的心，她的厨艺抓住他的胃，再来就能抓住他的心吗？不行，她又胡思乱想了。
终于，一颗颗饱满馄饨下锅，不一会儿汤就「咕噜咕噜」翻滚着，飘出令人垂涎三尺的味道。
「汤爷，您先试。」夏羽柔先舀一小碗给他，「小心烫。」
「不错。」他喝了一口。
「我也喝看看。」她也喝了一汤匙。

两人相视一笑，叶嬷嬷在一边看得眼弯弯。
content_en:
Xia Yurou asked herself, she really didn't, but she felt depressed and was about to speak when there were two knocks on the window.
Shen Alian blushed and said angrily: "Why are you here at this time, this piece of wood!"
Xia Yurou was sitting in Shen Alian's boudoir, so naturally she couldn't sit still. When she heard these words, she immediately sat upright, but what shocked her even more was that the window that was originally closed was blocked.
"This - this - Ah Rou, you didn't see it, no, you can't tell it. Ah Chun, he - my parents are too strict, but we want to meet, and who the hell bastard said that we can't meet each other for three months before we get married."
Xia Yurou looked at Shen Alian who was ashamed and angry. It must be said that at this time, she looked the most beautiful she had ever met.
Her face was filled with peach blossoms, and she was very shy. Looking at Ah Chun who was standing aside at a loss, she hit his chest with her left hand and squeezed his waist with her right hand, showing off her daughter's coquettishness.
Looking at Ah Chun again, he just giggled when Shen Alian's hands frequently moved towards him, then looked at her, nodded awkwardly as a greeting, thought for a moment, then touched his head in embarrassment and said, "On the day we get married, we are going to trouble Lady Xia."
"What are you, Miss Xia? She is my sister. You have to call her Sister Arou." Shen Alian glared at him again.
"Hello, Sister Arou, uh - please."
Although Ah Chun is still young, he has excellent facial features, tall body, and tanned skin. He is very suitable for Shen Alian and makes her a little bird.
Both of them asked her not to tell anyone about him climbing through the window.
"No, I swear." She promised again and again, raising her right hand seriously.
"Actually, Ah Chun feels bad. He is afraid that my father will think that he is disrespectful and disrespectful to me, but he can't resist me. I just want to see him, I want to see him, I really want to see him..."
Shen Alian looked at her sweet lover and said shyly, smiling so sweetly.
Facing such happy two people, a certain string in Xia Yurou's heart was touched. This scene actually lingered for a long time.
Returning to the large kitchen behind the Xia family canteen, Xia Yurou rolled up her sleeves to prepare for dinner, but she kept losing focus. Finally, she forced herself to ignore a certain voice in her head and cooked roast duck with all her strength.
The duck skin is bright in color when grilled, and the duck meat is tender and juicy, fat but not greasy. Some of it is stir-fried, and some of it is shaved into thin slices with skin on. It is wrapped in thin pancake rolls with green onion segments. It is delicious at first glance.
The four large stoves were used to stew or cook soup. Xia Yurou walked to a wooden frame and took out the bacon. From the small ice cellar, she took out the minced pork that she had bought at the nearest meat stall when she came back from Shen Alian. She also fished a live fish from the water tank.
When she cut open the fish neatly, steam was coming out of the pot on the other stove, and the aroma of the food floated out.
"Arou, I'm here."
It's Aunt Ye, Shen Alian's wedding banquet, and Aunt Ye wants to be her helper, so she will come over to help prepare dinner these days, and also eat together, and practice the wedding dishes first.
Today's roast duck is one of the two dishes, so she only cuts a small part of the duck meat and lets Grandma Ye practice the rest.
Xia Yurou paid attention to the time while busy. Tang Shaoxuan had come to class, so she had to move faster. She looked back at the dishes on the table and saw that the soup was still unmade. She started to mix the stuffing to wrap the pork wontons.
While he was busy, Tang Shaoxuan walked into the kitchen.
These days, although he would criticize her dishes unceremoniously, he would do so during meals in the dining room. He once said, "A gentleman is far away from the kitchen."
But now she didn't dare to complain. Her mood was complicated and she didn't even dare to look at him, because after leaving the Shen family, her mind kept revolving around Shen Alian's words——
"I just want to see him, I want to see him, I really want to see him..."
This made her unable to restrain her impulse on the way home, and she frequently looked in the direction of the quarry.
She knew that her heart was strongly clamoring to goSee him, go see him, go see him - every heartbeat is accompanied by these voices longing to see him.
But this is wrong, she is always a second cousin.
So today when Tang Shaoxuan came to class, she avoided his eyes for the first time, opened the door to let him in, and then went into the kitchen. Unlike in the past, she accompanied him all the way to her brother's room and talked endlessly.
Xia Yurou didn't know that it was her that made Tang Shaoxuan enter the kitchen for the first time.
He didn't know what was wrong with him, but he noticed that Xia Yurou was avoiding him and that he couldn't concentrate in class and was even irritable. He even asked Xia Yuchen, "What's wrong with Madam Xia today?"
"What's wrong, sister?"
Xia Yuchen's confused expression made him angry for no reason. There was something wrong with his sister, but his younger brother didn't even notice? So, as if out of anger, he gave him a lot of homework and went to the kitchen.
"Are you feeling unwell?" he asked.
My heart is gone, can I feel comfortable? She stared sadly at the man who stole her heart.
In the past, she had done everything possible to please and behave, letting Wu Yi, Shen Ming and others get her together with Tang Shaoxuan. She didn't care, thinking that it would never come true anyway, and even if it came true, she would be the one who earned it. But she never thought that she would give away her heart first. This deal was too uneconomical.
"Did I offend you?" Tang Shaoxuan asked again with a frown.
Of course it’s you, who else could it be if it wasn’t you? Heart thief! You still pretend to be innocent, I despise you! Xia Yurou cursed angrily in her heart.
Tang Shaoxuan frowned even more tightly, "Yin Yang Wei Qi, what's the matter with you?"
His face suddenly darkened, and she suddenly came back to her senses. She was going to die. Was she crazy? Forgot who he is?
With a strong desire to survive, she immediately came back to her senses and said, "No, no, no, there are too many things to do. Have you lost your mind? Mr. Tang, uh - why did you come in? Are you hungry? I've wrapped the wontons and put them in the pot. Dinner is ready. Just wait a moment."
Aunt Ye looked at the two of them with a smile without saying anything. Onlookers knew clearly that Tang Shaoxuan was concerned about Xia Yurou, otherwise he would not have come into this smoky kitchen.
As the sky got darker, Grandma Ye also joined the process of making wontons, and Xia Yurou also sped up her movements, but Tang did not do anything and only watched them wrap them. Grandma Ye was very happy with the two young people in the same room and talked a lot.
"Let me tell you, this wonton dish can also be used at the wedding banquet on the day of Alian's wedding. I have eaten it a few times and it is really delicious," she said without stopping, "I have loved eating this stuff since I was a child. My mother also said that the meat for the filling must be the best pork that was freshly slaughtered that day, and the skin must be..."
"Thin and elastic teeth." Tang Shaoxuan and Xia Yurou said in unison. One knows how to eat and the other knows how to cook. They have been going back and forth on food these days, and they really have a good understanding of each other.
"Hahaha, I didn't expect Ah Rou and Master Tang to have such a tacit understanding." Grandma Ye said with a smile.
"Isn't that right?" Xia Yurou smiled proudly, but when she thought of He Zhong's words, she blushed again. She and he had a spiritual connection... No, no, she forgot that she was a concubine again!
Tang Shaoxuan saw her expression changing again and again, "What's wrong?"
She twitched her lips and said, "It's okay. I just have a tacit understanding with Mr. Tang. I'm happy, haha." Inexplicable embarrassment, she accidentally used force and broke her skin. She muttered again, "What am I doing? Uh--Master Tang is probably too good-looking. I'm nervous when he's so close. Do you want to go out first? I'm a nymphomaniac."
Realizing what nonsense she had said, she covered her mouth without thinking, forgetting that her hands were covered in sticky raw meat fillings, and she hurried to the sink to spit it out.
Tang Shaoxuan smiled lowly.
Grandma Ye also laughed, looked back and forth between the two of them, and nodded frequently.
Why is she so embarrassed all the time? She is going crazy. Xia Yurou rinsed her mouth and thought about Tang Shaoxuan's increasing smiles recently——
Ask yourself, if he is happy, she is really happy, so if he steals her heart and captures his stomach with her cooking skills, then he canCapture his heart? No, she was having random thoughts again.
Finally, plump wontons were put into the pot one by one, and soon the soup was tumbling with a mouth-watering flavor.
"Master Tang, you try it first." Xia Yurou scooped out a small bowl for him, "Be careful not to burn it."
"Not bad." He took a sip.
"I'll drink it too." She also drank a tablespoon.
The two of them looked at each other and smiled, while Grandma Ye looked at them with eyes wide open.
